headline: Partner with RoboGrinder
intro: Companies, local businesses, families, and friends help our students design, build, and compete. Support RoboGrinder with funding, equipment, or expertise to keep our robots and our team moving through the season.

pageDescription: Partner with Virginia Tech's student-led RoboGrinder team. Connect with emerging engineering talent, share expertise, and help students build practical experience.
whoDescription: We’re a student-led engineering team at Virginia Tech, bringing students together since 2016. Members take ideas through design, build, and testing, learning to deliver as a team.
benefitsIntro: These benefits are available at eligible company donation tiers. Resume drops, events, and recognition depend on your sponsorship level.
supportTitle: Help the team build and compete.
supportIntro: From business sponsorships to support from family and friends, every contribution helps. Funding, equipment, and expertise cover the work in our lab and the costs of getting to competitions.
connectIntro: Tell us how you’d like to help. Whether you represent a business or want to contribute personally, we’d like to hear from you.
